children.name: Teams - User and Role Changes
children.description: The Teams - User and Role Changes dashboard provides insight on the user and role changes being applied in your environment.
children.title: Teams - User and Role Changes

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team* 
| json "Workload", "Operation" , "UserId", "CommunicationType", "ItemName", "Members[*].UPN", "Members[*].Role" as workload, operation, email, object_type, object_name, members_added_raw, member_role_raw
| where workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and (operation = "MemberAdded" or operation = "MemberRemoved" or operation = "MemberRoleChanged")
| count email
| sort by _count
| limit 5

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team* 
| json "Workload", "Operation" , "UserId", "CommunicationType", "ItemName", "Members[*].UPN", "Members[*].Role" as workload, operation, email, object_type, object_name, members_added_raw, member_role_raw
| where workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and operation = "MemberAdded"
| replace(members_added_raw, "[", "") as members_added_raw
| replace(members_added_raw, "\"", "") as members_added_raw
| replace(members_added_raw, ",", "\n") as members_added_raw
| replace(members_added_raw, "]", "") as members_added
| replace(member_role_raw, "[", "") as member_role_raw
| replace(member_role_raw, "\"", "") as member_role_raw
| replace(member_role_raw, ",", "\n") as member_role_raw
| replace(member_role_raw, "]", "") as member_role_number
| replace(member_role_number, "2", "Member") as member_role_number
| replace(member_role_number, "1", "Owner") as member_role_number
| replace(member_role_number, "3", "Guest") as member_role
| formatDate(_messageTime, "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss") as added_time
| count added_time, email, object_name, object_type, members_added, member_role
| fields -_count
| sort by added_time

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team* 
| json "Workload", "Operation" , "UserId", "CommunicationType", "ItemName", "Members[*].UPN", "Members[*].Role" as workload, operation, email, object_type, object_name, members_added_raw, member_role_raw
| where workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and (operation = "MemberAdded" or operation = "MemberRemoved" or operation = "MemberRoleChanged")
| count object_type
| sort by _count
| limit 5

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team*

| where workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and operation = "MemberRemoved"
| replace(members_removed_raw, "[", "") as members_removed_raw
| replace(members_removed_raw, "\"", "") as members_removed_raw
| replace(members_removed_raw, ",", "\n") as members_removed_raw
| replace(members_removed_raw, "]", "") as members_removed
| formatDate(_messageTime, "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss") as remove_time

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team* 
| json "Workload", "Operation" , "UserId", "CommunicationType", "ItemName", "Members[*].UPN", "Members[*].Role" as workload, operation, email, object_type, object_name, members_added_raw, member_role_raw

| count object_type, object_name
| sort _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team* 
| json "Workload", "Operation" , "UserId", "Members[*].UPN", "Members[*].Role", "TeamName" as workload, operation, email, members_changed_raw, member_role_raw, team_name
| where workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and operation = "MemberRoleChanged"
| replace(members_changed_raw, "[", "") as members_changed_raw
| replace(members_changed_raw, "\"", "") as members_changed_raw
| replace(members_changed_raw, ",", "\n") as members_changed_raw
| replace(members_changed_raw, "]", "") as members_changed
| replace(member_role_raw, "[", "") as member_role_raw
| replace(member_role_raw, "\"", "") as member_role_raw
| replace(member_role_raw, ",", "\n") as member_role_raw
| replace(member_role_raw, "]", "") as member_role_number
| replace(member_role_number, "2", "Member") as member_role_number
| replace(member_role_number, "1", "Owner") as member_role_number
| replace(member_role_number, "3", "Guest") as member_role
| formatDate(_messageTime, "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss") as change_time
| count change_time, email, team_name, members_changed, member_role
| fields -_count
| sort by change_time

_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Team* 
| json "Workload", "Operation" , "UserId", "CommunicationType", "ItemName", "Members[*].UPN", "Members[*].Role" as workload, operation, email, object_type, object_name, members_added_raw, member_role_raw
| where workload = "MicrosoftTeams" and (operation = "MemberAdded" or operation = "MemberRemoved" or operation = "MemberRoleChanged")
| timeslice 1d
| if(operation = "MemberAdded",1,0) as member_added
| if(operation = "MemberRemoved",1,0) as member_removed
| if(operation = "MemberRoleChanged",1,0) as member_role_changed
| sum(member_added) as members_added, sum(member_removed) as members_removed, sum(member_role_changed) as members_role_changed by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(1d)
